Plan to say why I cook most nights, propose ventilation and door-closure while cooking, offer to rinse/wipe my pans if we set a simple dish rule (whoever cooks washes that night or a short rota), and ask we split shared supplies costs.

Look — I cook most nights because I work from home; it's my break. I get that the smell and the dirty pan are annoying. Also I usually buy dish soap and gas — let's split those costs or put money in a shared jar.
Waiting to hear if they accept the proposal or want a different rule.
